cues.text: Here are the ten questions customers ask the most, and simple, friendly answers you can give.
Question 1. Will my stain come out? Answer: We will do our best. Most stains come out, but we can’t promise. What is it, and how old is it?
Question 2. When will it be ready? Answer: Your ready date is on your ticket. If you said yes to texts, we will text you when it’s ready.
Question 3. Can I get it faster? Answer: I can mark it RUSH. Let me check with my manager what day we can do.
Question 4. Why does silk or wool cost more? Answer: Delicate fabrics need extra time, care, and hand pressing.
Question 5. Is dry cleaning really dry? Answer: No. It uses a special cleaning liquid instead of water, so it’s gentle on your clothes.
Question 6. Will it shrink? Answer: Dry cleaning is the safest way to stop shrinking. That’s why we use it for wool and delicate clothes.
Question 7. Can you fix or shorten this? Answer: Yes! Our tailor does hems, zippers, buttons and repairs. Let me write it up.
Question 8. Do you pick up and deliver? Answer: Yes. I can schedule a pickup or a delivery for you.
Question 9. Why do you need my phone number? Answer: It finds your orders fast. If you agree, we text you when your order is ready.
Question 10. Something is wrong with my order. Answer: I’m sorry. Let me write down your ticket number and get my manager to help you.
Golden rules. Smile and stay calm.
Never promise money, refunds, or exact results. That is the manager’s job.
If you are not sure, it is always okay to say: let me check with my manager.
